title: 1F916 POST /api/witnesses/:id/countersignatures success response
description: What the registry answers a witness that pushes a countersignature row it already published. Three success arms, told apart by status and by accepted/deduplicated. 201: the row was new and is stored (accepted true; witness_id, log, tree_size, receipt and registry_public_key are all served). 200 with deduplicated true: the same (log, tree_size, root) was already stored, and the receipt is the stored one, not a new signature. 200 with accepted false: the witness already has a larger tree_size stored for this log, nothing was written, and reason says so. The receipt is the registry's Ed25519 signature over receipt.payload, verifiable with registry_public_key (or the key at GET /api/checkpoint). Refusals (400, 404, 409, 422) are the ordinary society error body and are not described here.

accepted.description: True when the registry holds this row for the witness after the call (new or repeated); false when a larger tree_size was already held and nothing was stored.

deduplicated.description: Present only when the identical row was already stored; the receipt is then the stored one.

reason.description: Present when accepted is false: why nothing was stored.

payload.description: 1f916.witness-receipt.v1:<origin>:<witness_id>:<epoch>:<log>:<tree_size>:<root>:<received_at>, the exact text the registry signed.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature over payload, base64url, unpadded.
